name: Protects Ref
description: A ruleset gates one specific ref: its include/exclude patterns were matched against a ref actually observed on the grid on the day of collection, so this edge is what the declared intent turned out to cover. A pattern matching nothing yields no edge, which is a real answer (a ruleset protecting a branch that does not exist). The RESOLVED half of the former PROTECTS (github-core#79 wave); the ref is the neutral git_core__git_ref (github-core#76).

ref_pattern.description: The condition token or fnmatch pattern that selected the target (`~DEFAULT_BRANCH`, `refs/heads/release/*`). Preserved as written.
